svg.title: Check what the camera showed in a voice chat
svg.desc: This practice drawing lets you check whether a spoken answer used the visible details. Draw. Make a yellow Review button and a blue Save button. Ask aloud. Which color is the Review button? Check. Compare the answer with the drawing, then stop sharing the camera.
